pieces.title: What survives at 24 pixels
pieces.caption: Crystal Synthesizer's hero and its avatar, each shrunk to 48 and 24 pixels and shown both at true size and enlarged. The hero turns to a smear of colour; the avatar is still a ring with a red stone in it. *What is real and what is a choice:* Both are the palace's real files, resized. Nothing was redrawn. *Leaking in:* Crystal Synthesizer, the page's own example of an engraving.
